units.source_text: 此时二条院内，源氏公子由于好不容易重返京都，格外疼爱可怜的紫姬，

en.t: At this time in the Nijo residence, because Prince Genji had at last returned to Kyoto, he cherished the poor Lady Murasaki with special tenderness,

units.source_text: 这里那里地正忙个不停。

en.t: and he was constantly busy here and there.

units.source_text: 因此凡是他所不甚重视的人，都不曾特地去访。

en.t: For that reason, he did not make a special effort to visit anyone he did not regard as especially important.
Needless to say, this included Suetsumuhana.

units.source_text: 公子有时记起她，也只推想此人大约无恙而已，

en.t: Even when the prince occasionally remembered her, he merely supposed that she was probably safe and well,
and felt no urgency to go and visit her.

units.source_text: 转瞬之间，这一年又告终了。

en.t: In the blink of an eye, that year too came to an end.
